specialTechnique.title: Graph algorithm cheat sheet
specialTechnique.body:
Unweighted shortest: BFS
Non-neg weighted: Dijkstra
Negative: Bellman-Ford
0-1 weights: 0-1 BFS
All pairs dense: Floyd
Dependencies: Kahn / DFS topo
Undirected cycle: DFS parent / DSU
Directed cycle: 3-color DFS / Kahn leftover
